entities.name: Erem
entities.description: Battle-hardened kor warrior of Zendikar, compleated in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who questioned Erem after returning wounded to Zendikar.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: Leader Erem fought beside at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who captured and compleated Erem.

events.summary: Erem meets wounded Nahiri during the Rise of the Eldrazi and bluntly questions her; he declines her offer of gear.
events.quote: Erem interacted with Nahiri after she returned to Zendikar

events.summary: Erem fights beside Tazri against the Phyrexians at Sea Gate.
events.quote: Erem participated in the intense battle at Sea Gate

events.summary: Erem is speared, captured and sealed in a seedpod, where the Phyrexians assimilate him.
events.quote: Erem was captured by the Phyrexians and sealed within the pod

relations.quote: He fought bravely alongside Tazri against the invading Phyrexian forces
